title: Turn notifications on after saying no
description: Short XRP Mobile tutorial: turn notifications on from Settings, General, after skipping them during setup. The switch hands over to iOS, which only asks for this permission once per install, so if you denied it long ago you have to allow it from the phone's own settings instead.
lede: You tapped I'll do it later when you set the wallet up, and now you only find out money arrived when you happen to open the app. Two taps fixes that.

steps.caption: Open XRP Mobile
steps.body: Open the app. Nothing you skipped during setup is lost: every one of those choices lives in settings afterwards.

steps.caption: Unlock as usual
steps.body: Unlock with your PIN, or your face if you turned that on.

steps.caption: Settings, General
steps.body: Tap the gear and stay on General. Notifications sits under your currency and your language.

steps.caption: Flip it on
steps.body: Flip the switch, and iOS steps in, because this permission belongs to the phone rather than to the app.

steps.caption: The phone asks, once
steps.body: Tap Allow. iOS only ever asks this once per install, so if you said no long ago the app cannot ask again and this switch would sit there doing nothing.

steps.caption: Now you'll know
steps.body: Done. From here you hear about money arriving the moment it lands, instead of the next time you happen to look.
